page: Vultr vbm-256c-3072gb-8-b200-gpu is a bare metal server configured for intensive computational workloads. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9575F processors, delivering 128 physical cores and 256 vCPUs at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 3072.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 12.0 GB of RAM per physical core.

The server integrates eight NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs, providing a combined total of 1536 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. Local storage is provided by 28608 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, offering high-speed data access directly on the bare metal hardware. The configuration also includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

This bare metal configuration represents a high-density hardware profile designed to eliminate virtualization overhead. The combination of massive GPU memory, high-core-count AMD EPYC processors, and extensive NVMe storage makes this server suitable for large-scale artificial intelligence workloads, deep learning training, massive parallel simulations, and complex data science pipelines.
